adjudicator: Claude Opus 5, reading the six fixture files only, with no access to any machine judgements
method: For each case labelled not_entailed I asked one question first: if the premise is true, must the hypothesis be false? I called it CONTRADICTED when the premise assigns the same slot elsewhere (role reversal, a named other office-holder, an explicit closure or denial, a stated exclusion) or when the natural reading of the premise makes the hypothesis false. I called it NEUTRAL when the premise merely fails to reach the hypothesis and a world in which the hypothesis is true is still consistent with the premise. For neutrals I then asked whether a careful but ordinary reader, given only the premise, would expect the hypothesis to be true; a real inferential pull (possession, association, a genuine but narrower role, a bounded instance of the same act) counts as plausible, while an arbitrary or unrelated widening does not. I deliberately did not use contradiction for cases where the premise only supplies an external cause or an unrelated role, since a cause outside the person does not exclude the person's own involvement.

cases.reason: The integration is said to be his and ongoing, which invites the reader to assume he takes part, but no role is stated and none is excluded.
A bare possessive names whose process it is and nothing else; active participation is neither given nor ruled out, but possession pulls toward it.
Temporal co-location with a recovery that is his makes participation a natural assumption without establishing it.
Appearing throughout a merger report strongly suggests involvement but is consistent with being only a subject of the record.
Taking no part in the negotiation makes active participation in it false (the present-tense hypothesis is read as the same negotiation).
The hypothesis explicitly denies he chaired the first hearing, which the premise asserts.
The grief is hers and sustained, which tempts a reader toward participation, but the premise assigns her no role in it.
The premise makes the storm the cause and the footbridge the thing that collapsed, so the storm is not what undergoes the collapse.
Recording with the quartet three times is consistent with membership and with being an outside collaborator; the repetition makes membership tempting.
The public gallery is the non-participant position at a negotiation, so watching from it excludes being an active party to it.
The premise makes the seedlings the thing acted upon; the hypothesis reverses the direction of effect.
The accident being the cause of the change does not exclude his taking part in it, but nothing in the premise pulls a reader toward his active involvement.
Being read into committee minutes is compatible with active participation and with being merely referred to; it invites the stronger reading.
In the scene described the inspector is the questioner and the foreman the questioned; the hypothesis puts the inspector in the wrong slot.
Declining to sit on the board makes board membership false.
Joining next spring entails he is not a member now.
The premise closes the interval at his injury, so the present-tense claim that he rows with the crew is false.
A process participating in its own product is unsupported rather than denied, and nothing in the premise makes it appealing.
The bakery closed in 2019, so Imre cannot presently manage it.
Serving on the lifeboat is placed before a move inland, which ends it.
Two covered shifts this year neither establish nor exclude a standing arrangement, and the fact that she has done it invites the habitual reading.
Being invited to sit in leaves membership open but reads as a guest, so nothing pulls a reader toward belonging.
Being listed among contributors leaves editorship possible but a catalogue that names her as a contributor gives no pull toward editor.
The premise names a different person as the archivist, so Mira is not the archivist.
The bare plural can be read as the whole set or as a generic statement about trees lost; under the weaker reading it holds, so it is not excluded, and it reads naturally.
One failure neither establishes nor rules out a dispositional fault, and a single Tuesday would not lead a reader to expect failure at every firing.
A summer intention does not exclude some earlier repainting but gives no reason to believe one occurred.
Delivery is still to come in March, so the depot does not have the engines.
Ability leaves the practice open, and the reading room is an unlicensed detail nothing in the premise suggests.
Supplying timber is consistent with also building boats but reads as a supplier's trade rather than a boatbuilder's.
The lease ended, closing the interval, so she does not run the shop now.
"No longer" states the present negation directly.
Piloting is placed before a move inland, which ends it.
Retirement from piloting makes the present-tense claim false.
Two appearances last season do not settle whether she is a current player, and having played for the side makes the claim tempting.
Giving it up ends the relation.
A trial period bounds what is reported without stating that he stopped, and the reader easily carries it forward.
"Stopped" negates the present relation outright.
A past date reports one year and says nothing about since; continuation is easy to assume and not excluded.
Resigning the keepership ends the maintenance relation.
Three printings neither establish nor exclude that she prints it as a standing matter.
Ceasing to print makes the present-tense claim false.
Conducting on one Tuesday is consistent with being the band's conductor and with a one-off, and the first reading is the tempting one.
"Used to" carries the implication that he no longer does.
Her teaching is placed before the funding was cut, which on the natural reading ended it.
Leaving the language exchange ends the teaching relation there.
The estate's sale closes the interval, so he does not tend the vineyard now.
Running the tea house is placed before a move to the coast, which ends it.
Joining after the fire excludes having worked there before it.
Three occasions neither establish nor exclude a standing role, and the count invites reading her as the walk's leader.
One completed season leaves a present stint possible but gives a reader no reason to expect one.
The post is being advertised and she is standing in, so she does not hold it.
Parting ways last autumn ends the working relation.
A conditional future neither establishes nor excludes the habit, and the premise presupposes she is the one who opens it.
Her wrist giving out closes the interval, so she does not climb with the team now.
Turning to cabinetmaking supersedes the bookbinding identity the hypothesis asserts.
The new director's arrival closes the interval of her keeping the logs.
Two stand-in occasions leave a presenting role open and make it easy to assume.
Outside May to September the crossing is by arrangement only, so there is no seven o'clock January ferry.
The rest of the week holds only white and wholemeal, so the rye is not baked every day.
He is named as a locum covering another vet's leave, which excludes his being the permanent vet.
The Sunday use is twice a year, which makes every Sunday false.
Last April the pots were lit on three nights, not on every April night.
Four days is not four months.
Femi is identified as her cousin, which excludes brother.
He has never worked a day shift there, so he does not guard the wing in the afternoons.
The heater comes on only under eight degrees, so it does not run regardless of temperature.
She returned in February and has raced without trouble since, so she is not currently injured.
The premise names Colin Frey as the chairman and Ruth as standing in for him.
The restoration was finished in spring 2022 and the lamp relit, so it is not still going on.
She attended as a guest of the friend who had enrolled, which places the enrolment with the friend and not with her.
In the years between the two floods the gauge never reached the flood mark, so flooding is not a most-years event.
An apprenticeship followed by her own kiln neither establishes nor excludes a later partnership, and nothing suggests one.
The pickers are taken on for a fortnight and five people work the vines the rest of the year.
After eleven at night the street has no service until morning, so there is none at three.
The volumes must stay in the building and access needs written permission, so no reader may take one home.
